items.title: Quantinuum Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Raises Full-Year Revenue Outlook
items.summary: Quantinuum Inc. (Nasdaq: QNT) (the "Company"), a leading full-stack quantum computing company, today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.

items.title: This Canadian tech stock is getting crushed as AI sell-off spreads across the mark
items.summary: Investing.com -- Canada’s technology sector is showing a widening divide as a global retreat from artificial intelligence trades hammers chip and hardware-linked stocks, while software companies and telecom providers prove more resilient, suggesting investors are shifting away from high-growth AI bets towards steadier businesses.
